name: Guess The Close
loop: Swipe whether an anonymised closed trade from the feed ended as a gain or a loss, then see the real result and its percentage.
hook: Uses the app own records, so every card teaches real outcome spread.
risk: Anonymised records may be re-identifiable; needs trader opt-in.

name: Feed Fork
loop: A game tab beside the feed re-serves closed trades with the result hidden; you guess, then swipe on to the next.
hook: Same swipe habit as the feed, with a stake in the answer.
risk: Guess results must never look like verified records.

name: Blind Profile
loop: Open a masked trader profile with its first ten trades; set a probability that trade eleven was a winner, then reveal.
risk: Reveal could out the trader; mask handle and dates.

name: Challenge Link Duel
loop: Send a link carrying five masked trades; a friend guesses the same five and the two scores are compared side by side.
hook: Instant rivalry with zero signup friction for the friend.
risk: Link must not leak trade identities.

name: Result Unfurl
loop: Game result link unfurls to a card with a bold PAPER GAME banner, score, and a distinct colour system from verified cards.
hook: Shareable brag without confusing it with a verified record.
risk: Look-alike styling could be mistaken for a record.

name: Spectate A Run
loop: Watch a friend paper-trade a run live, with their predictions hidden until each bar resolves, then cheer or react.
hook: Low-effort viewing; the friend is the content.
risk: Spectators may copy picks; label as paper, not advice.

name: Club Season
loop: Small clubs of up to twenty adults pool weekly run scores; the club total ranks against other clubs.
hook: Team loyalty brings people back weekly.
risk: Club chat can drift into tips; no free text.

name: Ghost Of The Feed
loop: Race the ghost of a friend who already guessed the same masked trade set, seeing their timing but not answers.
hook: Replays feel like live duels without scheduling.
risk: Ghost timing alone may reveal answers.

name: Gamer Badge On Profile
loop: Trader profiles may show a small hollow Game badge with calibration score, kept visually apart from the verified record block.
hook: Links game skill to a social identity.
risk: Mixing game and record on one page erodes trust.

name: Predict My Trade
loop: A trader opts in a just-opened position in masked form; followers set a probability it closes green; result shown when it closes.
hook: Followers get a live stake in a real trader outcome.
risk: Looks like a signal; may be read as advice.

name: Daily Masked Seven
loop: One shared set of seven masked closed trades per day; guess outcomes, post a spoiler-free emoji grid card.
risk: Streak anxiety; cap and forgive misses.

name: Mutual Friends Quiz
loop: Pick which of three followed traders made a shown masked trade, drawn from public profiles you follow.
hook: Teaches you who you follow by style.
risk: Reveals trade authorship patterns; opt-in only.

name: Roguelike Of Records
loop: Three-minute paper run through drawn market events; relics unlock from loops of real record patterns, ending in a share card.
hook: Fresh run each time with modifier twists.

name: Co-Op Pair Run
loop: Two friends share one paper wallet in a run; one calls entries, the other exits, scored on the pair outcome.
hook: Co-op creates shared stories to retell.
risk: Pressure on weaker partner; allow solo mode.

name: Class Rank Cards
loop: Collect cards representing masked trading styles; slot three per day and score by how their style hold up in the next resolved trades.
hook: Collecting plus prediction in one loop.
risk: Card rarity could become loot-box behavior.

name: Skill Tier Ribbon
loop: Play calibration rounds to earn a ribbon tier shown on the share card and optionally on the profile, never on the record tab.
risk: Ribbon may be read as endorsement of a trader.

name: Follow The Crowd Meter
loop: Guess how the crowd of players voted on a masked trade; score on closeness to the real crowd split, not market outcome.
risk: Conformity gaming; keep outcome link separate.

name: Reaction Replay
loop: Watch a replay of a closed trade as a candle story with live friend reactions at key moments, then guess the ending.

name: Weekly Club Bracket
loop: Clubs run a knockout bracket across the week; each head-to-head is one three-minute paper run on the same path.

name: Link Wager Paper
loop: Challenge a friend via link on a synthetic path; stake paper points on your own confidence, loser grants bragging rights.
risk: Points staking mimics betting; cap and rename.

name: Verified Vs Game Split
loop: Profile has two tabs, Record and Game; Game tab shows paper stats with a hatched border and a footer disclaimer.
hook: Clean separation of the two worlds.

name: Mentor Replay
loop: A trader opts to narrate their own closed trade as a story; viewers pick what they would examine at each decision point.
hook: Learning from real stories without advice.

name: Streak Sprint Quiz
loop: Swipe fast through masked records; streak builds a multiplier that resets on a miss, three sprints per day.

name: Calibration Mirror
loop: Give probabilities on masked trades; end screen is a calibration curve you can share as a card.
risk: Overconfidence insights may mislead; show sample size.

name: Trader Of The Day Guess
loop: Friends guess which profile ranks top by lower-bound return today; the friend league scores picks.
hook: Social league on top of existing ranking.
risk: Drives views to specific traders; fairness.

name: Paper Copy Cat
loop: Split a paper pot across masked closed trades that already resolved; compare with the trader on-record percentage.
hook: Teaches position sizing with real outcomes.
risk: Resembles copy-trading; avoid language of copying.

name: Open Position Vote
loop: On profiles with open positions, vote up or down on close direction; tally appears beside the position.
risk: Crowd tally could sway the trader or read as signal.

name: Season Pass Of Calibration
loop: Eight-week seasons rank players on average Brier score across weekly question sets; reset between seasons.

name: Share-Safe Receipt
loop: After a run, receive a receipt card with stamped PAPER and synthetic-path labels, with a tear-off edge that cannot hide.
risk: Crops can strip the stamp; repeat watermark.

name: Group Chat Mystery
loop: Link opens a room where up to six friends guess the same masked trade together, answers lock then reveal at once.
risk: Rooms can leak into real-world copying.

name: Anon Hall Of Losses
loop: Guess how bad an anonymised loser was; the closer to its true loss, the better, so losses get equal screen time.
hook: Honours losses, matching the product rule.
risk: Sensitive for the trader; opt-in and masked.

name: Fan Club Pools
loop: Followers of a trader form a pool and predict that trader next five closed trades outcomes; pool score is shown, not the trader.

name: Replay Roulette
loop: Spin a masked historical path with a random modifier like thin liquidity or gap days; play it for three minutes.

name: Stand-In Trader
loop: Play through a real masked trader sequence of entries as that trader, deciding hold or exit; compare to their recorded action.
hook: You learn by stepping into real records.

name: Team Calibration Card
loop: Club calibration is the average of members; the card shows the club curve and the most overconfident corner.
risk: Public shaming of the weakest; show club only.

name: Embed Game Widget
loop: A tiny widget lets any trader embed a three-card guess game on their site for visitors, linking back to their profile.
risk: Embed on off-site pages needs consent and no tracking.

name: Quiet Hours Quiz
loop: One daily set, locked after quiet hours begin, with a message that the game is closed until morning.
hook: Healthy cadence is part of the brand.

name: Cliffhanger Cards
loop: Share a card that shows the first half of a masked trade path; the friend swipes to guess the second half.

name: Verified Mode Locked
loop: Game score never touches verified stats, but verified traders unlock a gold frame on their game card.
risk: Seems to buy trust; frame may overweight verification.

name: Ask The Feed
loop: Inline in the feed, a tiny up or down guess appears before each result; tapping reveals the true result.
hook: Zero-friction entry from the main surface.

name: Rival Of The Week
loop: Matched weekly to a friend of similar skill; whoever guesses more of ten masked trades wins the week.

name: Skill Ghost Library
loop: Save your best run as a ghost; others can race it, and your ghost earns a visit counter.
hook: Your work keeps playing for you.
risk: Counter chase; no rewards for visits.

name: Adults Gate Lobby
loop: The game lobby checks the existing adult attestation before showing any play or share links.
hook: Compliance is part of the flow.

name: Newsroom Cards
loop: Weekly story missions replay a named historical market episode; share the debrief card with what you learned.
risk: Named episodes risk third-party names; use generic descriptions.

name: Public Calibration Wall
loop: A wall of anonymous calibration curves per player, ranked by lower-bound sample-adjusted score.
hook: Applies the app lower-bound ranking to games too.
risk: Gaming small samples; require minimum count.

name: Win-Rate Duel
loop: Two players guess outcomes of a trader last ten masked trades; each card also shows that trader win rate.

name: Loss Story Mode
loop: Followers watch a trader walk through a recorded loss and answer comprehension questions; no scores shared.

name: Seasonal Paper League
loop: Rank-and-promote paper league: runs scored by risk-adjusted return across a shared weekly path set.

name: Cohort Cards
loop: Build a three-card hand of style tags; friends guess your hand from your pattern of answers.

name: Mini Prediction Market
loop: Private friend group posts questions on delayed prices; each friend gives a probability and the group average is the market.
risk: Delayed live data licensing; paper only.

name: Streak Insurance
loop: A single missed day does not break your streak; a gentle forgiveness token resets weekly.

name: Replay The Reply
loop: A friend leaves a voice-free emoji annotation on a masked trade; you must guess the result before reading the note.
risk: Free annotation text could slip advice.

name: Reveal Party
loop: Weekly live event: hosts reveal a masked trade set, audience guesses in real time, the aggregate heats up on a shared screen.
risk: Event pressure; hosts must keep tone neutral.

name: Trader Pages Pre-Game
loop: Before opening a profile, guess its win rate within a range; the closer you are, the more you see of their gallery.
hook: Turns profile browsing into a game.
risk: Gating info behind play may annoy.

name: Mask Hunter
loop: Given a masked trade with hints on holding time and return, rank which of four profiles it likely came from.

name: Newbie Sandbox
loop: New players try a gentle synthetic run before joining social features, with explicit tutorial labels.
risk: Synthetic paths may teach false patterns.

name: Skill Gifts
loop: Gift a friend a cosmetic frame for their game card via link, earned only from calibration and never bought.
risk: Cosmetic trading could become a market.

name: Cross-Club Swap
loop: Clubs swap one masked trade question each week; the other club answers and both get a combined board.

name: Social Proof Prompt
loop: Show the crowd guess after your lock-in; you can revise once, and the score counts only the first guess.

name: Journal Tie-In
loop: Traders attach a private note to their own closed trades; later a game round quizzes them on their own past calibration.
risk: Personal notes are personal data; keep private.

name: Public Domain Charts
loop: Share cards use a cartoon chart that is intentionally not a real candle style, so they cannot be mistaken for a record.

name: Referral Duel
loop: Invite a friend through a link; they play a free demo duel before signing up, and both see a single result card.

name: Weekly Club Report
loop: Each club gets a weekly report card with total calibration, most improved member and a club motto.

name: Spoiler Free Thread
loop: A comment thread for a masked trade stays hidden until you answer; replies appear only after your guess.

name: Rank Ladder Of Records
loop: Players ranked by how well they predict outcomes of verified-record trades, by lower-bound score, not frequency.

name: Mini Tournament Link
loop: Spin up a four-player knockout via one link; all four play the same path, best paper return advances.

name: Trader Opt-In Quests
loop: Traders may publish a short quest from their own closed trades; players follow the setup and guess the exit.

name: Moment Of Truth
loop: A masked trade runs in time lapse; hold while you believe it is rising, release to exit, and compare with the real exit.

name: Anon Pair Compare
loop: Two masked trades side by side; swipe toward the one with higher return, then see both.
risk: Ranking realised returns may feel like advice.

name: Friendly Spread
loop: Daily range question: drag a band that should contain tomorrow replayed move; friend board shows who was tight and right.
risk: Wide bands game coverage; reward tightness.

name: Verified-Only Arena
loop: An arena that only uses verified-record trades for questions, labeled The Records Arena, with game scores kept elsewhere.
risk: Players mistake scores for ability to trade.

name: Show Your Work
loop: After revealing, a quick tap tags why you guessed it; the card shows your top three habits.

name: Feed Takeover Mode
loop: During a live club night the feed temporarily displays the club board and shared guesses alongside records.

name: Tiny Pet Analyst
loop: A pet mascot grows with your calibration; it looks sad when you are overconfident, never when you lose.

name: Learn With Friends
loop: Friends take a mini-course of synthetic scenarios together; unlocks happen only when all complete.

name: Hold-Your-Nerve Duel
loop: Both players hold through the same path; whoever lets go with the better risk-adjusted outcome wins.

name: Crowd Lens
loop: See how all players guessed each masked trade, split by skill tier; learn where experts and novices diverge.

name: Sunday Review
loop: Weekly review round re-asks your worst-calibrated questions with fresh masked trades; friends cheer progress.

name: Prize-Free Trophies
loop: Season winners get a one-off trophy frame; no cash, no perks, retired at season end.

name: Share Invite Gating
loop: Sharing a game result requires first reading a one-line disclaimer that the link is a paper game, not a record.

name: Public Replays Of Players
loop: Top players may publish run replays that others can scrub and annotate to learn their decisions.

name: Mixed Wallet Demo
loop: Allocate a paper wallet across three masked closed trades and one synthetic one; learn diversification, then reveal.

name: Brand-Free Boss
loop: Each run ends with a boss event path like a crash or a squeeze, with a unique modifier for your next run.

name: Pals Map
loop: A map of friends shows who played today and their calibration glow; tap to challenge.

name: Profile Prediction Pins
loop: Pin a prediction on a trader profile about its next close, visible to friends only; score builds a private record.
risk: Creates a second record that may be mistaken for verified.

name: Replay Roundtable
loop: A host guides a group through five masked trades live, pausing for audience votes before each reveal.

name: Meta Game Of Records
loop: Guess aggregate facts about the app: how many closed trades last week ended green; closest wins.

name: Edge Of Evidence
loop: Log-scored rounds punish certainty when wrong; the share card shows your boldest hit and boldest miss.

name: Speed Swipe Party
loop: Forty-five second swipe battle on masked trades with a friend over a link; most correct wins.

name: Collective Quest
loop: The whole community pools correct answers toward a weekly shared goal, unlocking a themed set of cards.

name: Honest Odds Board
loop: Daily next-close direction question with a probability slider; a public board ranks by calibration, clearly paper.
hook: True live stakes with no money.
risk: Perceived as signal; show unknown results first.

name: Ghost Of The Past Me
loop: Race a ghost of your own earlier run on the same path to track improvement.

name: Reverse Reveal
loop: See the final percentage first; guess the path shape from four options, then see the true path.

name: Offline Club Night
loop: A club picks a night; all play at once and a shared screen on a table shows the live board.

name: Pass-The-Phone Mode
loop: Two people share a phone, each taking a turn on the same masked path in turns of thirty seconds.

name: Hot Take Cooldown
loop: Friends post one probability on tomorrow close direction; a cooldown hides everyone answers until all lock or the day ends.
risk: Seen as signals; keep paper label.

name: Trade Autopsy Club
loop: A club studies one masked closed trade per week, votes on what drove it, then sees the trader own optional note.
risk: Trader notes may sound like advice.

name: Skill Passport
loop: A portable card summarises calibration, sample size and play style, with a confidence band and a bold not-a-record label.
risk: Passport may be shown as credentials.

name: Rivals Feed Strip
loop: A strip atop the feed shows friends current guess streaks on today masked set; tap to join their round.

name: Verified Echo
loop: Predict a followed trader next closed trade, then compare with the verified outcome; the game score is held in a separate private ledger.
hook: Bold bridge between game and real records.
risk: Mixes forecast and verified record; confusing.
